sites.name: Compact Sidewalk Strip
sites.description: Narrow São Paulo pedestrian sidewalk planting strip (< 1.5 m wide) beneath low-voltage overhead distribution wires, surrounded by concrete pavement and compacted urban subsoil.

requirements.municipal_reference: Portaria SVMA nº 26/2024 & Plano Municipal de Arborização Urbana (PMAU)

ecological_goals: Pedestrian thermal comfort without Enel distribution wire conflicts
Urban pollinator stepping-stone corridor for native stingless bees

sites.name: Sunny Degraded Lot
sites.description: Open, sun-exposed degraded vacant parcel or pocket park (20–50 m²) without overhead utility wires, requiring rapid canopy closure, nitrogen/organic matter recovery, and soil stabilization.
ecological_goals: Rapid pioneer canopy nucleating microclimate cooling (urban heat island mitigation)
Topsoil decompaction, leaf-litter generation, and erosion control
High-nectar and zoochoric fruit production to attract urban birds and pollinators

sites.name: Shaded Courtyard
sites.description: Protected residential, school, or community courtyard (15–30 m²) framed by mid-rise buildings with filtered light to deep shade, moderate soil volume, and no overhead utility lines.

requirements.municipal_reference: Portaria SVMA nº 26/2024, BioSampa (5ª Edição) & PMAU

ecological_goals: Multi-strata Atlantic Forest understory establishment under low-lux conditions
Year-round native berry and nectar resources for urban avifauna and hummingbirds
Quiet community biodiversity pocket aligned with UN SDG Target 11.7

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Compact fruiting small tree providing high-value zoochoric berries without sidewalk or utility-line conflict.

initial_month.task: Deep establishment watering (10 L per seedling) and organic mulch ring check
initial_month.notes: Keep mulch 5 cm clear of the trunk collar to prevent rot.

initial_month.task: Verify bamboo tutor stake and biodegradable figure-8 tie tension
initial_month.notes: Ensure sidewalk pedestrian clearance of at least 1.2 m.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Top-dress planting basin with 2 kg cured compost and remove invasive grasses
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Hand-pull weeds inside the 60 cm permeable collar; never use herbicides.

annual.task: Light formative crown-lifting prune below 1.8 m pedestrian clearance
annual.notes: Follow PMAU pruning standards; never top the central leader.

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Resilient heliophilous pioneer tree that colonizes compacted, sun-baked urban soils and feeds frugivorous birds.

initial_month.task: Establishment basin watering (12 L) and erosion berm inspection
initial_month.notes: Repair soil basin rims after heavy São Paulo summer convective rains.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Clear competing Brachiaria grass within a 1 m radius and replenish leaf-litter mulch
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Wear gardening gloves when handling resinous twigs.

annual.task: Structural inspection of co-dominant stems and removal of dead lower branches
annual.notes: Do not plant beneath overhead wires; matures to 7.0 m.

pollinators: Mamangava carpenter bees (Xylocopa spp.) — buzz pollination
seed_dispersers_avifauna: Wind-dispersed micro-seeds; canopy shelters insectivorous warblers
ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Signature Atlantic Forest pioneer tree whose white-to-magenta blooms sustain large native buzz-pollinating bees.

initial_month.task: Deep root-zone irrigation (10 L) and dual-stake wind stabilization
initial_month.notes: Brittle young wood benefits from double-staking in open lots.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Apply organic humate/compost mulch and check soil moisture during dry winter spells
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Maintain 8 cm wood-chip layer to buffer surface soil temperature.

annual.task: Remove dry post-flowering twigs and inspect branch unions
annual.notes: Excluded from wired sidewalks because mature height reaches 6.0 m.

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Hyper-fast Atlantic Forest regeneration nucleator creating instant shade and abundant infructescences for vertebrate dispersers.

initial_month.task: Water root ball (15 L) and establish 1 m weed-free mulched circle
initial_month.notes: Plant at least 4 m away from boundary walls and structures.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Leave fallen palmate leaves in situ as natural nutrient-cycling mulch
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Mutualistic Azteca ants may colonize hollow stems — ecological indicator, do not apply pesticides.

annual.task: Monitor canopy spread and understory natural seedling recruitment
annual.notes: Strictly restricted to open wire-free lots (matures to 10.0 m).

seed_dispersers_avifauna: Autochorous ballistic pods; dense branching provides safe nesting cover for Cambacica (Coereba flaveola)
ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Nitrogen-fixing leguminous shrub safe beneath power lines while supplying crimson nectar blooms across dry winter months.

initial_month.task: Water planting pocket (6 L) and firm soil around fibrous root ball
initial_month.notes: Avoid synthetic high-nitrogen fertilizers; Fabaceae nodulates naturally.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Tip-pinch lateral shoots encroaching onto sidewalk curb or footpath
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Maintains dense flowering habit while preserving pedestrian sightlines.

annual.task: Rejuvenation trim of oldest 20% woody stems after peak winter flowering
annual.notes: Fully wire-safe at 2.5 m mature height.

botanical.biome_origin: Mata Atlântica (Endemic — Serra do Mar / Planalto Paulistano)

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Threatened endemic namesake of São Paulo's Cambuci district, producing aromatic saucer-shaped fruits in sheltered courtyards and restored lots.

initial_month.task: Consistent moisture watering (10 L) and deep organic leaf-mold mulching
initial_month.notes: Sensitive to root desiccation during establishment; amend pit with cured compost.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Replenish organic mulch and supplement irrigation during dry June–August weeks
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Preserve peeling trunk bark — natural Myrtaceae characteristic, never scrape.

annual.task: Harvest fallen ripe fruits for community seed-sharing and remove crossing dead twigs
annual.notes: Slow-growing conservation flagship species (4.5 m mature height).

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Compact, smooth-barked native guava thriving in narrow sunny sidewalk strips and degraded lots while feeding urban tanagers.

initial_month.task: Deep watering (8 L) and check tutor stake tie alignment
initial_month.notes: Position fruiting crown away from curb parking doors on narrow strips.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Sweep fallen overripe fruit from paved walkway and add to compost ring
maintenance_quarterly.frequency: Every 3 months (weekly check during summer fruiting)
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Keeps pedestrian pavement slip-free while recycling nutrients.

annual.task: Formative pruning of basal suckers to maintain clean single or multi-stem trunk
annual.notes: Wire-safe compact stature (4.0 m mature height).

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Shade-adapted Atlantic Forest understory shrub delivering golden berries and dense foliar refuge inside low-lux urban courtyards.

initial_month.task: Gentle root-zone watering (6 L) and 6 cm shredded leaf-litter mulch application
initial_month.notes: Avoid waterlogging courtyard planters; ensure free drainage.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Top-dress with worm castings (húmus de minhoca) and inspect shade foliage health
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Thrives in filtered courtyard light without heavy pruning.

annual.task: Sanitary removal of interior deadwood only
annual.notes: Preserve natural rounded understory shrub architecture (3.0 m mature height).

ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Hardy terrestrial rosette groundcover stabilizing sunny soil pockets with scarlet floral bracts and yellow berries, without phytotelmata water-pooling.

initial_month.task: Soil-level watering (3 L) in coarse well-drained substrate setback 40 cm from curb walkways
initial_month.notes: Set back from narrow pedestrian edges using thick leather gloves due to spiny leaf margins.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Clear wind-blown litter around rosette clump and thin excess offset pups near walkway edges
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Non-tank terrestrial bromeliad (does not impound stagnant mosquito water).

annual.task: Divide and transplant mature offset pups to bare patches in the planting bed
annual.notes: Ultra-low profile (0.9 m) with zero overhead wire risk.

seed_dispersers_avifauna: Coleirinho (Sporophila caerulescens) and granivorous songbirds feeding on nutlets
ecological_interactions.ecological_role: Versatile perennial Atlantic Forest subshrub providing nearly continuous tubular red flowers for urban hummingbirds across sun and courtyard shade.

initial_month.task: Water root zone (4 L) and pinch terminal shoot tips to encourage bushy branching
initial_month.notes: Mulch lightly with fine compost to retain surface moisture.

maintenance_quarterly.task: Deadhead spent flower spikes to stimulate continuous hummingbird-friendly blooms
maintenance_quarterly.notes: Leave 20% of dried spikes in autumn for native seed-eating finches.

annual.task: Cut back woody stems by one-third in early spring and propagate stem cuttings
annual.notes: Wire-safe subshrub (1.2 m) suitable for all 3 São Paulo site archetypes.
